Original Fractal Space code is licensed under the MIT License, with copyright held by Alex Vaos.

The Levitated adaptations retain their GNU GPL terms and Jared Tarbell’s author credit. Third-party material keeps its own terms.

The mathematical experiments—Newton basins, Hopf fibers, Torus knots, Gyroid, Reaction–diffusion, Clifford attractor, Klein bottle, Torus, Möbius strip, Schwarz lantern, Sierpiński triangle, Koch snowflake, Double pendulum, Orbital gravity, Interference pool, Rössler attractor, Magnetic pendulums, Orbit ink, Fibonacci sculpture, Mountain terrain, Ripple plane, Ball drop, Liquid cursor, and Spectrum analyzer—are MIT-licensed JavaScript implementations. The Klein bottle parametrization adapts a Three.js example; its MIT author notice is preserved. Equations, references, and numerical notes ↗

Orbit Breach is an original MIT-licensed polygon-survival game by Alex Vaos, inspired by the broad play format of Super Hexagon by Terry Cavanagh. Its code and graphics are original.
